title: aidd release-notes --json
description: The Specs shipped since a tag or a date, grouped as Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 (Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security, in that order; only groups with entries), for users or for developers.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

audience.description: `users`: feat, fix, perf, and security changes, and any labelled `audience:users`. `developers`: every change.

id.description: The item's id, such as a Spec id.

intent.description: The first paragraph of the Spec's Intent, as plain text.

flags.description: The flags it ships behind, with their default.

removes_flags.description: Flags it removes: the feature is on for everyone.

merged_on.description: The newest commit in the window that changed its scope.

groups.description: A shipped Spec goes to the group its `changelog:<group>` label names, else Security for the security type or a fix with the security dimension, else Added for feat, Fixed for fix, and Changed for the rest.
